title: Broncos safety Brandon Jones goes 3-for-4 filling in for kicker Wil Lutz at training camp

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Broncos safety Brandon Jones goes 3-for-4 filling in for kicker Wil Lutz at training camp
sources.description: The Broncos have only one kicker on their 90-man roster: Wil Lutz, who missed Saturday's practice to attend former teammate Drew Brees' induction into the Pro Football Hall of Fame.
